Sum_t n_f(t)=#E and sum_{|W|=2} B_f(W) = p*#E exactly. Full-fiber selection satisfies B=n*|W_full| by definition; empty full-fiber windows are reported as empty, never assigned a density. The nonempty WX full-fiber window must reject the false universal per-window equation B=|W|.

Exact lifted point lists and canonical relation counts remain unchanged for each k. Coordinate-function expressions and membership costs may change and are charged; no flat support prediction is imposed.

incidence.expected: Exactly the divisors satisfying sum=O correspond to rank-3 jet matrices and to fully split sections. Weighted relation total N_p^3. Equality and all control predicates must hold exactly; no numerical tolerance.
Exact same accepted (D,c) pairs. This is the established linear-equivalence baseline and must be reproduced before the strictness comparison.
Every ordinary linear row gives c dot X=0 and Q1(X)=0, but Q2(X)=-1=4 mod 5. Reject before recovery. Certificate contains X,c, linear residual 0 and curve-membership residual 4.

The affine support satisfies x=1 and y^2=3, which has no F5 root (squares are 0,1,4). O has multiplicity 2; unresolved degree is 2. Reject as a split F5 relation while retaining that it is a rational section with extension-field support. Certificate lists the square-residue witness, O multiplicity and unresolved degree.

All four ordinary evaluation rows vanish; with t=x at P the section is t^2, so coefficient [t^2] is 1 and the required order-4 condition fails. Recovered divisor is 2[(0,1)]+2[(0,4)]. Reject the claimed pair (4[P],c). Independently check the group sum of 4[P]; the controlled expected value is (3,4), not O, obtained from the frozen group-law formulas, not a run result.
Recover D=4[O], with rank-3 A_D and a one-dimensional kernel. At O, c0*u^2 has order 4. Rejecting this indicates a pole-deficit or projective-chart error.
Recover precisely this degree-4 divisor with multiplicity two on each affine point; its group sum is O.

Every finite Eprime point fails original membership by residual 1. The common 4[O] section is explicitly allowed; do not demand a rejection there. In particular c=[1:4:0:0] recovers (1,2)+(1,3)+2[O] on Eprime; both finite points have original E residual 1. Linear-system dimension and low degree alone must not certify an E relation. Comparison counts on Eprime are descriptive controls, not an ECDLP conclusion.

evidence_required_per_case: Exact source and fixture input bytes or complete content-addressed embedded payload, with before/after identity and symlink/hardlink metadata.
Exact argv, cwd, external authority/lock hashes, actual native/executable/environment/dependency/claim fields and timestamps.
Whether normal admission succeeded, whether child/sentinel entered, actual status/exit/error type+message, specific postflight predicates.
Complete stdout/stderr bytes, every output/partial path, hashes/bytes, missing/extra/path-alias observations and resource sampling boundaries.
Actual attempt outcome and limitations. Unexpected failures retained; no invented command output, timing, probe, test or review.
synthetic_test_policy.replay: Future QA derives its own test assertions from this frozen contract and old actual observations. Do not run old replay scripts unchanged, bypass checks, reuse original scratch namespace, reuse old native provenance, or treat source custody as execution.

prospective_watchdog_amendment.reason: Finite five-case serialization/enumeration can be stalled by integration defects. A 1800-second per-process watchdog checkpoints a nonterminating attempt while preserving partials; the same machine protection already exists on the paired models instrument. This is prospective machine protection, not a scientific wall/CPU budget or campaign spending cap.
prospective_watchdog_amendment.effectivity: Engineering fixtures use their much smaller declared watchdogs. Any actual scientific launch must separately publish this process policy with the exact run contract; original advisory null wall/CPU budgets and five fixed samples remain unchanged.

repair_contract.review_boundary: Fresh independent review-adversarial at literal ultra after implementation snapshot, operational scope only; review_plan null. No mathematical claim-changing review or Lean task is opened by this engineering planning record.

archived_regression_source.rule: qa_check_index selects the exact immutable original observation and input recipe. Rebuild only into approved successor fixtures; preserve the original bytes/history.

additional_control_expectations.E01: Accept exact mapping as metadata only, with parent-published fixture lock. No real output directory or scientific import.
additional_control_expectations.E02: Source-v3 CLI forwards exact spec/config/context to fixed benign sentinel at scratch output only; no scientific module import; full matching profile manifest.
additional_control_expectations.E03: Mutate only named component of otherwise admitted clean fixture; parent publishes its expected lock digest when testing inner validation. Refuse named gate before output or sentinel, retain exact bytes/error identity.
additional_control_expectations.E04: After genuine initial admission, mutate only disposable copy of named file/state; refuse before mkdir/child with exact failed predicate.
additional_control_expectations.E05: After normal child start, mutate only disposable named fixture file/state; retain its before/after bytes and exact false postflight predicate; valid remains false.
additional_control_expectations.E06: Omit one declared stdout.txt; parent must either create its owned exact capture before finalization or report missing artifact, never silently drop frozen filename.
additional_control_expectations.E07: Benign fixture omits one nonlog original profile file. Final validity false; missing list exact; do not fabricate placeholder scientific output.
additional_control_expectations.E08: Fixture-owned aliases/barrier race stay inside scratch; target hash unchanged; exclusive no-follow creation refuses; full alias metadata and terminal diagnostic preserved. No mutation of real source or user files.
additional_control_expectations.E09: Barrier observation shows complete flushed/fsynced companions/profile hashing before exclusive final manifest publication; manifest contains no self-hash.
additional_control_expectations.E10: A scratch-only actor creates reserved manifest path at explicit barrier before publication; no overwrite, deterministic refusal and preserved preexisting bytes. Record actual race outcome; static inspection is not a raced control.
additional_control_expectations.E11: Only explicitly allowed benign canary is present with exact configured value; inherited disallowed canary absent; no secret environment values read or archived.
additional_control_expectations.E12: Introduce a single undeclared fixture tree file after start; fail only tree check where all other predicates remain true; compare against clean same-shape baseline.
additional_control_expectations.E13: Replace disposable source file with byte-identical different inode between phases; identity drift refuses even though SHA remains equal.
additional_control_expectations.E14: Declared root/non-POSIX/missing resource support case refuses in deterministic metadata check; label actual host mechanism untested if no appropriate host was used; never escalate or invoke root for this control.

ranking.basis: Existing nine concrete failures affect two approved ECC instruments. Completing this source-bound repair question reduces an actual admission uncertainty before new instrumentation design; current scientific launch would fail required gates and doing nothing resolves none.
ranking.mathematical_value_claim: No novelty, exponent improvement, attack-cost or measured-performance claim.

knowledge_promotion.not_warranted: Operational repair specification and custody only; no new replicated/strong scientific evidence or durable mathematical finding.
